definition_origin: Venture Coinist X post and user-supplied TradingView chart
source_claim: Bitcoin buying opportunities occur when Bitcoin 30-day realized volatility falls below QQQ 30-day realized volatility.
source_fidelity_notes: The supplied image supports the broad relative-volatility claim but does not expose machine-readable marker dates or indicator code. Exact source-marker reproduction is therefore not claimed.
decision_information: At the regular QQQ close, use QQQ adjusted closes through that session and only BTC UTC daily closes whose availability timestamp is no later than the QQQ decision timestamp.
target_instrument: BTC spot; research return proxy is Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily close
timezone: QQQ decisions use America/New_York regular-session close; BTC closes use UTC midnight availability
trigger_rule: On comparable QQQ trading dates, calculate sample standard deviation of close-to-close log returns within the preceding 30 calendar days. Annualize BTC with sqrt(365) and QQQ with sqrt(252). Trigger only on a fresh crossover from BTC realized volatility greater than or equal to QQQ realized volatility to strictly below it. Re-arm only after BTC realized volatility returns to greater than or equal to QQQ realized volatility.
entry_rule: Enter the research return calculation at the first completed BTC UTC daily close strictly after the QQQ-close decision timestamp.
exit_rule: Score 30, 90, 180 and 365 calendar-day exits independently at the first BTC UTC daily close on or after the target date. Also score a separate exit at the first BTC close after a comparable-date recross to BTC realized volatility greater than or equal to QQQ realized volatility.
direction_rule: Long BTC only; no leverage and no short variant in the canonical test.
cost_model: Subtract 20 basis points round trip from every event return. This is a frozen conservative research allowance for fees and slippage; funding is not applicable to the spot proxy.
benchmark: Unconditional BTC forward returns from all eligible QQQ trading-date observations, matched by trigger calendar year and holding horizon. Buy-and-hold is reported as context, not the primary conditional benchmark.
out_of_sample_boundary: 2026-08-04. All earlier history is source-exposed because the chart displayed historical markers; 2014-09-17 through 2021-12-31 is development and 2022-01-01 through 2026-08-03 is labeled historical validation but not untouched.
invalid_regimes: QQQ volatility spike caused by a narrow event rather than broad risk
fewer than ten independent historical triggers
one market cycle dominates the result
regime_proxy: Classify BTC using its 200-day moving average and trailing 90-calendar-day return into bull expansion, post-bear accumulation, bear contraction, or late-bull/transition. These are price-only research proxies and do not claim to measure global liquidity directly.

data_source.raw_payload_hashing: SHA-256 stored in each backtest output
data_source.failure_policy: Fail rather than silently substitute another provider

missing_data_rule: Skip observations lacking a valid close. Require at least 25 BTC returns and 13 QQQ returns inside the 30-calendar-day window.
primary_research_target: At the 90-calendar-day horizon, determine whether the signal's mean after-cost return improves by at least 25% relative to the absolute mean of the calendar-year-matched unconditional benchmark.
secondary_outputs: maximum adverse excursion and path drawdown

historical_advancement_gate.required_target_improvement: at least 25% versus the predeclared matched benchmark
historical_advancement_gate.effect_of_passing: watchlist and untouched shadow monitoring only; no capital rights

production_gate.required_90_day_after_cost_edge: positive and at least 25% above the matched benchmark
production_gate.required_confidence_interval: 95% bootstrap interval must not be materially negative
production_gate.required_regime_coverage: positive evidence in more than one predeclared regime

deactivation_rule: Retire or redesign the canonical signal if ten untouched prospective triggers show non-positive 90-day after-cost edge versus the matched benchmark, if the trigger cannot be reproduced from archived source data, or if performance is attributable to one event or one market cycle.
